# QYL0406: Direct GenAI SDK call bypasses automatic OTel instrumentation

<!-- <auto-generated /> This file is generated by tools/Qyl.OpenTelemetry.SemanticConventions.Analyzers.DocsGenerator. -->

| -- | -- |

| Analyzer | `Qyl0406DirectGenAiSdkUsageAnalyzer` |

## Description

Calling a GenAI SDK type directly prevents automatic OpenTelemetry span emission. Wrap the provider client through Microsoft.Extensions.AI.IChatClient so all LLM calls are traced without changes to call sites.
